title: sdr-daily-scratchpad-jordan-lee-2026-03-04
content:
Day: 2026-03-04 - Quick scratchpad / call list / follow-ups
Owner: Jordan Lee (SDR)
Goal for today: 30 dials, 10 connects, 5 qualified meetings booked. Focus vertical: fintech (payments, risk).

Morning plan (9:00 - 11:30)
- 9:00 - 9:30: triage inbox, sequence status, follow-up emails for yesterday's connects
- 9:30 - 10:30: outbound block (hot leads from demo request list)
- 10:30 - 11:30: inbound qualification + calendar work

Call list (priority)
1) PayForward / CTO: Connor Mills - last touched 3/2, voicemail left.
   - Notes: asked about latency concerns for real-time fraud scoring. Mention Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput.
   - Next: send one-pager + request intro to infra lead. Email template: short, include perf numbers for 512-token avg, ask for 15-min.
2) NovaPay / Head of Product: Sarah Patel - interested in embeddings for transaction categorization.
   - Notes: demo booked for 3/6, need to prepare example prompts and cost estimate. Bring up Redwood Optimize recommendations re: quantization.
   - Next: prepare 2 example prompts and cost sketch, ping Alex (solutions) for pricing notes.
3) Zentrust / Engineering Manager: Ben Ortiz - concerned about PII.
   - Notes: wants Private deployment / VPC options and KMS integration details. Shared security docs but wants a short architecture slide.
   - Next: request SRE/priv infra slide from Private deployment team (Olivia).
4) Ledgerly / Head Data Science: Mei Tan - no response after 2 emails.
   - Notes: possibly out of office. Try call at 11:00 local PST. If no answer, send 'value-add' note with a small eval idea.
5) ClearRoute / Ops: Ryan Cole - demo yesterday, asks about latency SLOs under batch requests.
   - Notes: gave rough numbers; he wants official SLA doc.
   - Next: attach SLA PDF + propose 2-week pilot on Dedicated. Follow up by EOD.

Follow-ups / To-dos (in order)
- [ ] Send PayForward one-pager (template: perf + pricing) - target: 10:30am
- [ ] Prep NovaPay prompt examples and cost sketch - target: 5pm (need Alex input)
- [ ] Ask Olivia for Private deploy slide deck (security) - ASAP
- [ ] Attach SLA doc to ClearRoute thread - before EOD
- [ ] Chase Ledgerly again (call + short eval idea) - after lunch

Meeting notes (quick)
- 3/3 discovery with ClearRoute: latency during spikes is main concern. They have bursty load (EB spikes). Suggested routing policy + fallback to smaller variant to maintain latency. Follow up with concrete numbers and pilot proposal.

Email/snippet templates (copy/paste)
- PayForward intro:
  "Connor — quick follow up on voicemail. Redwood Inference helps teams get predictable low-latency LLM inference with dedicated pools or private deployments. For use cases like real-time fraud scoring, teams see steady 50-100ms tail latency with Dedicated configs. Can I send a 1-page with numbers and propose 15 min tomorrow?"

- Ledgerly re-engage:
  "Mei — missed you earlier. Thought of a small eval you could try: 5000 txn rows -> embedding + similarity for anomaly buckets (I can provision a sandbox). Want me to set this up?"

Pipeline quick snapshot (manual counts)
- MQLs assigned: 12
- Active sequences: 28
- Meetings scheduled (this week): 7
- High-priority pilots: 2 (ClearRoute, NovaPay)

Blocks / questions
- Need official SLA doc link (ask ops / product).
- Who owns pricing for Dedicated pilots? Alex M. or Solutions? (pinged Alex).
- Private deploy slide: need KMS/HSM bullet and data flow diagram (Olivia to provide).

Notes to self / reminders
- Keep outreach < 4 touches per account this week (avoid burnout).
- Track response rates by template - add a small sheet if response falls below 8%.
- Log any security questions to Confluence page for reuse.

Quick wins for today
- Re-send personalized case study to ClearRoute with SLA excerpt.
- Small inline cost sketch for NovaPay to avoid price friction during demo.

Timestamped activity log (quick)
- 09:12 - Sent PayForward one-pager (draft).
- 09:45 - Call with unknown number (voicemail) — likely follow-up from inbound form. Left callback.
- 10:05 - Updated NovaPay notes with example prompts.

Links / refs
- playbooks: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sales-playbooks
- security FAQ: CONFLUENCE-SEC-049

End of scratchpad (will tidy and move to CRM notes later).
